standard_prerequisites.name: Augmentation Cech complex
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the horizontal arrows of the double complex (rows exact, evaluating to a_*I^q in degree 0).

standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of restriction
standard_prerequisites.use: Restriction to C_p exact, so I_p^bullet represents K_p.

standard_prerequisites.name: Injectivity of restrictions
standard_prerequisites.use: I_p^q injective on C_p, so column cohomology computes R^q a_{p,*} K_p.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 2019-2032): for K in D^+(C_total) and an augmentation a_0 towards a site D as in Remark remark-augmentation-site, there is a functorial spectral sequence with E_1^{p,q} = R^q a_{p,*} K_p converging to R^{p+q} a_* K.

Double complex (proof lines 2034-2042): with I^bullet a bounded-below injective representative of K, form A^{p,q} = a_{p,*} I_p^q; horizontal arrows from the augmentation Cech complex lemma, vertical from the differentials.

Row and column analysis (lines 2044-2055): rows exact in positive degrees evaluating to a_* I^q in degree 0; restriction exact so I_p^bullet represents K_p; I_p^q injective on C_p, so column cohomology computes R^q a_{p,*} K_p; conclude with the Homology first-quadrant machinery.
proof_roadmap: Build the double complex of pushed-forward injectives.
Check rows exact (augmentation Cech complex) and columns computing R^q a_{p,*} K_p.
Apply the standard spectral sequence machinery.
difficulty_reason: Spectral-sequence lemma (statement 2019-2032, proof 2034-2055): the augmentation spectral sequence - the double complex a_{p,*}I_p^q is constructed, rows exact by the augmentation Cech complex, columns computing R^q a_{p,*}K_p by exact restriction and injectivity preservation; the machinery application completes the argument; every step present or named. H2.
